caption: The video captures a close, static view of a smooth cyan-blue dome resting in a shallow pool of matching blue liquid inside a white container. Two curved, horn-like blue shapes flank the dome in the background and stay fixed in place throughout. Bright specular highlights sit on the dome's upper surface, shifting and re-forming gently over time. A thin white squiggly line lies at the dome's lower-left base, wiggling and changing its curve as the surface moves. The dome itself holds the same position and overall silhouette, showing no translation or deformation. The white container edges remain steady, keeping the framing unchanged. The surface motion continues quietly, neither starting nor resolving in view.
